Author: JustPixelll
Name: Should I?
Punchline: Sell smarter. Buy smarter. Learn your trading style.
Description: One FFXIV Market Board suite containing Should I Sell?, Should I Buy?, and Should I Tycoon?: selling guidance, budget-aware opportunity scanning, vendor and stack arbitrage analysis, confirmed purchase cost-basis capture, personal sales history, and trader performance analytics.
Changelog:
# Should I? v1.1.1

Focused **Should I Buy?** usability and portfolio-control update.

## Opportunity table
- Rating is visible in both the main opportunities table and the budget basket.
- Main rows highlight across the full table width and open the opportunity analysis when clicked.
- Every main column is sortable with visible ascending/descending state.
- Scanner controls, headers and key metrics now explain themselves on hover.

## Budget portfolio
- Adds a player-set basket cap from 1 to 20 positions, defaulting to 8.
- The cap is enforced inside the capital allocator together with the gil budget rather than trimming the displayed result afterward.

## Opportunity detail page
- Clicking an opportunity now opens a dedicated analysis page with Back navigation.
- Adds acquisition package, average and maximum buy price, existing/resulting position, exit price and stack plan, listing count, potential and risk-adjusted profit, ROI, capital efficiency, demand evidence, sale samples, market freshness, exact acquisition listings, score methodology, model notes and LIVE VERIFY.

Recommendations remain read-only; Should I? never automatically purchases Market Board listings.
